requirements.text: For these users, check the Service Desk HR Service Desk Group to confirm if they are already members
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE member_id = 44 AND group_id = 4 AND user_id = 50 AND org_id = 1
assumptions: implied by the request, not stated: confirming whether they are already members implies adding those who are not, and the add-member tool is available
the only active admin with last name Clark is Sara Clark (user 50); the other Clarks (43, 66, 81) are agents
the Service Desk HR Service Desk Group is group 4, 'HR Service Desk' (type Service Desk); user 50 is not a member in the seed
id assumed next in sequence (highest member_id in the seed is 43)
org_id 1, the organisation of both the group and the user; every seed membership carries its group's org_id

disagreement: org_id on the new membership: A 1, B untested; chose 1, the tighter predicate, because group 4 and Sara Clark both belong to organisation 1 and all 43 seed memberships carry their group's org_id

requirements.text: identify all active admin users with the last name Clark
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 4 AND user_id IN (43, 66, 81)
assumptions: users 43, 66 and 81 share the last name Clark and are active but are agents, not admins, so they fall outside the set and must not be added

requirements.text: check the Service Desk HR Service Desk Group
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE user_id = 50 AND group_id IN (3, 11, 12)
assumptions: groups 3 (Global Service Desk), 11 (HR Case Readers) and 12 (Secure Case Access) also have type Service Desk but are not the HR Service Desk group, so the user must not be added to them; this is the boundary of the group selector

requirements.text: update the Employee Profile Update service to use lifecycle event as its fulfillment type and apply the Office Based Employees criteria
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_service WHERE hr_service_id = 35 AND service_name = 'Employee Profile Update' AND fulfillment_type = 'lifecycle event' AND hr_criteria = 6 AND topic_detail = 28 AND service_template IS NULL
assumptions: Employee Profile Update is hr_service 35 (fulfillment manual and no criteria in the seed)
Office Based Employees is hr_criteria 6, active in the seed, so the condition for the update holds
'lifecycle event' is the policy's enumeration value for that fulfillment type
topic_detail 28 and service_template NULL kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy (both are the seed values)

notes:
disagreement: org_id on the new membership: A 1, B untested; chose 1, the tighter predicate, because group 4 and Sara Clark both belong to organisation 1 and all 43 seed memberships carry their group's org_id
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that Sara Clark is not added to groups 3, 11 or 12, present in one pass only; kept because those are the seed's other groups of type Service Desk (3 is Global Service Desk), the rows a loose reading of 'the Service Desk HR Service Desk Group' sweeps in, so the stay is the boundary of the group selector
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that no service other than 35 takes the Office Based Employees criteria, present in one pass only; dropped because the request asks only to list those services and leaves the alignment to the requester, no seed service carries any criteria (so no loose reading picks out a particular service to change), and a stay over every other service is a general invariant on collateral changes, which are measured separately
The two passes otherwise agree on the membership, the stay on the agent Clarks, the service update and both dispositions (kept); their texts and assumptions differ in wording only.
Verifying that the criteria is active and listing the other active services that share it are read-only and write nothing; no service in the seed has any hr_criteria, so the list is empty before the update.
The request states only a membership check; adding user 50 to group 4 is required because its wording ('already members') and the available add-member tool imply the add, as the benchmark's check expects, though a reader of the request alone could take the step as a read-only audit.
The acting user (Karen Watkins) is an admin, whom the policy allows to change service configuration and group membership.
